messages:
Emma: Heads up — ap-northeast-1 privnet keystore IAM tighten just started causing NATGW conntrack exhaustion. GPU warm pool failing to complete keystore handshake, seeing a big audit log spike. Anyone else?
Raj: Yep seeing it, alerted via pager. Prewarm failures correlate with bursts of keystore auth traffic from the GPU nodes.
Luis: That change landed in the tf apply last night (policy scope narrowing). Snippet: ```json
{
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Deny",
    "Action": ["sts:AssumeRole"],
    "Condition": {
      "StringNotEquals": {
        "aws:SourceVpce": "vpce-0abcde12345"
      }
    }
  }]
}
```
Luis: The deny is tightening some of the service role handoffs; keystore retries are exploding audit throughput which is saturating conntrack on the NATs.
oncall-sre: Conntrack metrics: ```
# conntrack -S | grep entries
entries: 986432
max: 1000000
# netstat -s | grep "connections" -A1
TCP: 198842 active connections
```
oncall-sre: Warm pool: 18/30 ready (was 28/30 pre-change). 12 nodes stuck at keystore handshake step.
Emma: Can we either revert the policy or temporarily allow the NATGW vpc endpoint(s) to bypass the new condition? Reverting is fastest if low blast radius.
Raj: We can bump net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max to 2M as short term (sysctl), but that's workaround; policy should be fixed. Sysctl commands: ```bash
sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=2000000
echo 2000000 > /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max
```
Raj: We'll need to patch the NAT autoscaling too if connection count stays high.
Luis: I'll prepare a revert PR to the tf state to restore the previous policy scope and mark it with urgent tag. If someone can approve, I can apply now.
Emma: Approve from oncall, go ahead. :thumbsup:
oncall-sre: Please also add a short-term allowlist for the keystore VPC endpoint id on the policy so the keystore service still uses the intended auth path instead of falling back to IAM calls from nodes.
Luis: Adding the allowlist as a fast patch + revert plan. Will include rollback instructions.
DeployBot: Terraform apply started by Luis (plan: plan-7821).
DeployBot: Terraform apply completed (plan-7821) — 1 resource changed (aws_iam_policy_document keystore-policy). run_id=apply-2026-04-03-21:07
oncall-sre: Observability — conntrack entries dropping: 980k -> 220k in last 5m, warm pool recovering.
Emma: Warm pool back to 24/30 ready, keystore handshake failures trending down.
Raj: Followups: 1) revert the temporary allowlist after keystore fix, 2) add rate-limiting on keystore retries, 3) runbook update for IAM tightening impacts on NATGW conntrack.
Luis: Will own the TF revert and followups. Filing a ticket in infra (INFRA-4932).
Emma: Thanks. Leaving monitoring on for next 2 hours. If we see >80% conntrack again, escalate to network oncall.
